subject: Post-signature launch playbook and initial access plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Eliza Gomez <eliza.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps — post-signature launch plan (initial asks)

Congrats on signing, Eliza — excited to get Nimbus moving. Monica / implementation team: high level asks from the kickoff call today so we can triage tasks and get the tenant primed

Summary of what Nimbus needs from Redwood to start:
- Dedicated tenant creation (region: us-west-2)
- Admin seed: 3 service accounts + 2 human admin invites
- API key provisioning pattern and rotation policy to meet their compliance
- Initial project namespace and rate limit targets (10 RPS burst, 2 RPS steady)

Eliza — Raj from your infra team will be our security contact for the SOC2 checklist and KMS integration. Can you confirm Raj's availability for a 45-minute implementation kickoff next week?

I attached a short playbook and the tenant matrix to this thread for reference. Monica — can you propose a 2-week launch runway with milestones (admin seed, API keys, first test deploy, verification)?

Thanks,
Ben
--
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Nimbus-Post-Signature-Playbook.pdf, initial-tenant-matrix.xlsx

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Eliza Gomez <eliza.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — post-signature launch plan (initial asks)

Thanks Ben — Eliza, glad to partner on the rollout. Draft runbook below (high level) — I suggest we use a sprint model with two 1-week sprints: readiness and activation.

Sprint 0 (Readiness) — by 2026-05-24:
- Tenant created in us-west-2 (Jonas)
- Admin seed: create 3 service accounts (infra, ingestion, eval) and invite 2 human admins (Eliza, Raj)
- KMS integration plan reviewed (David to provide KMS checklist)
- Share API key naming convention and rotation cadence (we recommend 30-day rotation for initial phase)

Sprint 1 (Activation) — by 2026-05-31:
- Service accounts provisioned and API keys issued (Jonas)
- Initial project namespace and sample workload deployed by Nimbus engineering (Eliza/Raj)
- Smoke tests run (latency, key rotation, RBAC) and signed off by Nimbus

Deliverables and owners:
- Tenant provisioning (owner: Jonas Weber)
- API key policy & initial keys (owner: Jonas Weber / David Kim)
- Security evidence (SOC2 summary, owner: Monica Patel)
- Kickoff meeting scheduled (owner: Ben Carter)

Eliza — does the proposed runway map to your post-contract expectations? If you approve, we'll schedule the kickoff and I'll share a more granular task board (Drive link attached).

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial-tenant-matrix.xlsx

From: Eliza Gomez <eliza.gomez@nimbushealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Security <security@nimbushealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — post-signature launch plan (initial asks)

Thanks, Monica and Ben — that looks good. A couple of questions from our side:
1) For the 3 service accounts, can we request scoped roles (read-only ingestion, eval-runner, admin-proxy) rather than full tenant-admin by default? We want least privilege out of the gate.
2) KMS integration: we run keys in AWS KMS. David, will your checklist cover envelope encryption and the expected audit events for key usage?

Raj is available for the kickoff on Tuesday 2026-05-25 between 09:00–11:00 PT. I'll confirm a calendar invite once Ben proposes a slot. Also looping in our security email for SOC2 evidence — if you can attach the summary, that's helpful for procurement.

Cheers,
Eliza
Head of ML Platform, Nimbus Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Gomez <eliza.gomez@nimbushealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps — post-signature launch plan (initial asks)

Eliza — good call on least-privilege. We'll provision three scoped service accounts with the following initial roles:
- svc-ingest: role.ingest (limited to ingestion APIs, no admin ops)
- svc-eval: role.eval-run (able to create ephemeral evaluation queries only)
- svc-admin-proxy: role.proxy-admin (can request temporary elevation via RBAC approval ticket)

API key policy notes:
- Keys issued will be labeled with namespace and role (e.g., nimbus-ingest-202605)
- Rotation: support automatic rotation, we'll seed initial keys and provide a rotation script. Recommend 30-day rotation as Monica suggested; can extend to 90 days after maturity.
- Audit: key usage is logged to our tenant audit stream; David will confirm the log fields that map to Nimbus's SOC2 needs.

I've started the tenant creation job (us-west-2) and expect provisioning to complete by EOD 2026-05-18. Monica — I'll share the service account credentials securely (Vault link) once the tenant is ready.

Jonas
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: provisioning-job-id: prov-20260518-84

Monica
